artworks.title: Portrait of an Oblate Sister of Providence
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays a full-length portrait of a person in a religious habit, facing the camera with a neutral expression. They are holding a book and standing beside a chair with a patterned cushion. The background consists of a draped curtain and a textured backdrop, with a plush floor covering in the lower part of the image.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned photograph showing six individuals: four women and two children. The composition includes three women standing in the back and one woman seated in the front center, accompanied by two young girls on either side of her. The seated woman wears a high-necked dress with a lace collar, and her hair is tied back with a ribbon or bow. The two standing women on the right wear dark coats with hats, one of which features fur detailing. The woman on the left is dressed in a plaid patterned dress with puffed sleeves, and she has long, curled hair. The children, both girls, are dressed in light-colored dresses; one girl has a bow in her hair, whereas the other wears a cap. The girls stand on either side of the seated woman, and their expressions and poses are neutrally composed. The setting appears to be a studio with a plain backdrop. The bottom of the photograph is labeled "Wertheim, Imperial Studio, 21 E. Balto. St., Baltimore, Md."

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The photograph depicts a family portrait featuring eight individuals, including adults and children. The adults are seated in front, while some of the children sit or stand around them. The adults, a man, and a woman, are positioned towards the center and right side of the image. The woman has a composed facial expression and wears her hair pulled back, dressed in a long, patterned gown adorned with lace and high collars. The man, also formally dressed, has short hair and a mustache and wears a suit with a high-collared jacket. The children are arranged around the adults, with the younger ones sitting or standing in the front, wearing typical dresses or suits of the period, while two stand at the back wearing similar formal attire. The children's expressions vary, with some looking directly at the camera. Two boys are in suits, and the girls wear dresses, some with lace detailing. The backdrop of the image is plain and neutral, typical of a studio setting from that era, with minimal distractions to focus on the family group. There are no visible accessories such as jewelry or objects being held.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a man, woman, and child in three-quarter views. The man is seated in a wooden chair with his hands clasped, wearing a suit with a vest and chain. The woman stands by his side, wearing a dark, ornate gown with lace and embellishments. The child, sitting on a small chair, wears a buttoned-up jacket, shorts, knee-high socks, and boots. The background shows a faint image of a large castle-like building and stairs, with a fur throw on the floor.

artworks.title: "Joella's Group"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows four young children. The central child standing at the back wears a light-colored shirt. Flanking the central child are two children sitting on a cushioned seat draped with fringed fabric. Both have short, textured hair and wear patterned dresses, stockings, and laced boots. The child on the right rests their arm on the seat, with legs crossed and hands on their knees. The child seated in the front wears a darker dress with lace detailing and has curled hair styled into a top bun with ribbons or a bow. This child wears bracelets and looks slightly away from the camera. The children are surrounded by ornately patterned fabric covering the furniture and a textured backdrop, likely in a photography studio.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Boys
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The photograph features two young boys standing side by side. The boy on the left has light-colored short hair and is standing with one leg slightly bent. He rests his arm on the chair's armrest. The boy on the right has short dark hair and leans with his arm on an ornately carved wooden chair. Both boys wear matching outfits with dark jackets, light-colored collars, knee-length shorts, and high-button boots. The backdrop is a plain wall with visible floor. Additionally, there are two chairs in the image: an upholstered chair with fringe on the left and an ornately carved wooden chair with patterned fabric on the right.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman and Children
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals from the waist up. On the left is a seated woman with a calm expression, wearing a dark top and white skirt. Next to her is a young girl in light-colored clothing. On the right is a young boy in similar attire, seated on a rock. The background features a painted backdrop of ferns and foliage.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Child
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man holding a young child on his lap. The man has a warm expression with deep lines on his face and short, white hair. He wears a white shirt, dark vest, and light trousers while sitting in a wooden chair. One of his hands rests on the arm of the chair, and he holds a hat in his other hand. The child is dressed in a light-colored frock with a checkered pattern and lace trim. They have a short haircut, wear a checkered cap, and boots. Behind them is a wall of patterned bricks with a wooden window and wood plank flooring.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting on a chair, captured from the side. She is turned slightly sideways, with her left arm resting on the backrest of the chair and her right hand on her lap. Her face is in profile, showing her facial features including lips and nose. Her hair is styled back with volume on top, and she is wearing drop earrings. She is dressed in a dark-colored satin dress with lace detailing on the sleeves and neckline. The background is a plain backdrop. Her left leg is extended slightly, revealing a stocking and a shoe with a bow. There is a unique shape near her leg. The photograph seems to be a cabinet card with the name "Johnson" and a Chicago address at the bottom.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Wearing a Fraternal Ribbon
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on a wooden walkway. He is wearing a dark suit, a light-colored waistcoat, a white shirt, and a dark overcoat with a sash. He has distinct facial features, including prominent cheekbones and a straight nose. The man also wears a dark wide-brimmed hat, and the background features dense foliage and trees, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing with his arms crossed, holding a gun in his left hand. He has short, neat hair and wears a dark suit with a hat. The background shows a painted backdrop with drapery and a vase on a pedestal. The man has rounded tip shoes.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals: a seated man, a woman standing to his right, and a young girl standing to his left. The man, seated on a wooden chair, holds a rifle upright. The woman stands to his right, her left arm resting on his shoulder. The young girl stands to his left. The man has a serious expression, thick dark facial hair and short curly hair. He wears a three-piece suit over a white shirt. The woman wears a dark, long-sleeved dress with lace details and a white bow, and round glasses. The girl wears a checkered dress with dark stockings and ankle boots. The background features a neutral-toned curtain, a wooden fence, and a wall on the left side. The room's floor is covered with a plain fabric in a period style.

artworks.title: Adeline Purnell
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation

artworks.title: Portrait of Men with Telephone Equipment
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Holding Tools
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image portrays a person standing, facing the camera with a slight body tilt and looking downward. The individual has short hair and distinct facial features. They are wearing a long-sleeved shirt and a long apron. The person holds an object in each hand, and the background shows decorative architectural elements in an indoor setting. The photo is framed by a red-lined border on an off-white card with ornate corners.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Holding a Basket
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright at a slight angle, looking towards the camera. He is wearing a hat, a light-colored shirt, a tie, a jacket, and a white apron over his clothes. One hand is in his pocket and the other is resting against his side. A woven or cane chair with materials draped over it is nearby. The background is a plain wall with light markings or stains.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man with a Barrel
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing next to a large wooden barrel. He has a beard and a serious expression, wearing a hat, a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a vest, and work trousers. He is operating a handle on the barrel. A chair is partially visible beside him, and the background features a textured backdrop, possibly a patterned curtain or cloth.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man with a Violin and Horn
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays a man holding a violin and bow across his lap. He is seated and dressed in a light-colored jacket, white shirt, patterned tie, and matching trousers. Next to him on a table with patterned cloth is a brass instrument. The background shows a vintage-styled interior setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of Bicycle Racers
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing closely together, each holding onto a bicycle. The man on the left has a mustache and is wearing a cap, the central man also wears a cap and has hair peeking out underneath, and the third man on the right is also wearing a cap. Each man is dressed in period-appropriate attire with knee-high socks and shoes. The background features an artificial backdrop with a pattern resembling trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Cutting Hair
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two men. One man is sitting with his legs crossed and hands resting on lap. He has light-colored hair, a thick mustache, and is wearing a dark-colored outfit with a white cloth draped around his shoulders like a barber's cape. The man standing behind him has short, dark hair and is holding a pair of scissors. He is dressed in a shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a waistcoat. The chair they're using is made of branches. The background is a plain, textured surface, typical of older photography, with no discernible details.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and a Boy
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals captured from the waist up. The person on the left is standing, with their arms resting on an unidentified object, possibly a tool, while the person on the right is seated with one leg crossed over the other. The individual on the left has textured, possibly curly hair, and wears a loose shirt with suspenders. The person on the right has a mustache, and short hair, and is wearing a hat, collared shirt, bow tie, vest, and overcoat. The seated individual holds an object in their left hand, and a chain hangs from their vest. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Hidden Woman and Child
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person covered with a large dark cloth or blanket, hiding their entire body and face. A young child sits on their lap, facing forward with a slight turn of the head to the left. The child has wide eyes, closed lips, short, curly hair, and is dressed in a light-colored, long-sleeved garment with lace trim, stockings, and dark shoes. The background features a studio-like setting with faint, painted elements resembling foliage and an ornate structure on the right side.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Soldier
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright in a studio setting. He is facing the camera with his arms relaxed by his sides. The man has curly hair, a mustache, and is wearing a tall, dark fur hat. He is dressed in a buttoned, dark suit with matching trousers and dark shoes. The background shows a painted scene with a column and a tree, creating an outdoor setting appearance in an indoor photograph. No visible jewelry or objects are present.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Soldier
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This image shows a person standing upright. The individual is facing the camera directly. The person has short hair and distinct facial features. They are wearing a uniform with a jacket, trousers, and gloves, and a hat sits on their head. A bandolier filled with ammunition is draped across the chest, and the person is holding a pistol in one hand. The background of the image appears plain and textured. The photo is an old and stained tintype image, giving it a sepia tone.
